 nodes=[[root(phase),-1,-1,0]]; discovered={root(phase):0}; edges=[]; skips=[]; expanded=[]
 head=0; found=None; status='running'
 try:
  while head<len(nodes) and found is None:
   if head%128==0: guard()
   idx=head; head+=1; q,_,_,distance=nodes[idx]; tried=0
   for gi,g in enumerate(LETTERS):
    tried|=1<<gi
    if forbidden(q,g): skips.append([idx,gi]); continue
    nxt=G(g,q)&MASK; assert nxt==cells(g,q,14)
    fresh=nxt not in discovered
    if fresh:
     childidx=len(nodes); discovered[nxt]=childidx; nodes.append([nxt,idx,gi,distance+1]); assert len(nodes)<=M
    else: childidx=discovered[nxt]
    edges.append([idx,gi,nxt,childidx,int(fresh)])
    if nxt==TARGET:
     found=childidx; break
   expanded.append([idx,tried])
  status='target_found' if found is not None else 'exhausted_unreachable'
 except TimeoutError:
  status='incomplete_time_cap'
 letters=[]; path=[]
 if found is not None:
  i=found
  while i>=0:
   path.append(i)
   if nodes[i][1]>=0: letters.append(LETTERS[nodes[i][2]])
   i=nodes[i][1]
  letters.reverse(); path.reverse()
 record={'phase':phase,'root_residue':root(phase),'status':status,'visited_node_count':len(nodes),
  'processed_nodes_including_final_partial':len(expanded),'fully_expanded_node_count':sum(mask==7 for _,mask in expanded),
  'allowed_edges_traversed_and_cell_checked':len(edges),'forbidden_edges_skipped':len(skips),
  'discovered_level_counts':dict(sorted(Counter(row[3] for row in nodes).items())),
  'fully_expanded_level_counts':dict(sorted(Counter(nodes[i][3] for i,mask in expanded if mask==7).items())),
  'target_node_index':found,'target_distance':None if found is None else nodes[found][3],
  'shortest_zero_cost_rooted_word':None if found is None else phase+''.join(letters),
  'target_path_node_indices':path,'nodes':nodes,'traversed_edges':edges,'forbidden_edges':skips,'expanded_rows':expanded,
  'node_encoding':['residue','parent_discovery_index','incoming_letter_index_t_u_p','distance'],
  'edge_encoding':['source_discovery_index','letter_index','target_residue','target_discovery_index','new_discovery'],
  'expanded_row_encoding':['discovery_index','tried_letter_bitmask'],
  'visited_discovery_table_sha256':objsha(nodes),'visited_sorted_residues_sha256':objsha(sorted(discovered)),
  'runtime_seconds':time.monotonic()-before,'cpu_seconds':time.process_time()-beforecpu}

  assert all(any(idx==i and mask==7 for idx,mask in expanded) for i,node in enumerate(nodes) if node[3]<distance-1)
